name: Kurokawa
source:
One of the younger nurses. She is an annoying, self-deprecating, and clingy type of person who holds a grudge. 

She says she doesn't care about herself anyway, but if she has to take a break, she will harass Yamada in the name of revenge. She sees Yamada as her own kind and is obsessed with him in every way possible.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
